problem: A railway train has $6$ passenger wagons. How many ways can $6$ conductors be distributed among the wagons if one conductor is assigned to each wagon?
worked_solution:
There are $6$  conductors to arrange, so there are $6!$ ways of arranging them:

$$
\begin{aligned}6! & =6\times 5\times \times 3\times 2\times 1 \\  & =720.\end{aligned}
$$
